plugin.note: Cows have very low Defence and barely fight back, so any weapon clears them. They drop cowhide for a little profit, making the Lumbridge cow field a classic low-level spot.

requirements: No requirement to be assigned Cows by Turael; Spria requires combat level 5.
No Slayer level or quest requirement.
Cow calves and dairy cows also count toward the task.
mechanics: Cows have 8 Hitpoints and max hit 1 (crush); they do not fight back unless attacked.
Cows have no elemental weakness and are 100% resistant to poison and venom.
Cows drop cowhide, so the task is a mildly profitable starter Slayer-XP task.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill Cows in the Lumbridge cow field or Falador farm with any melee weapon.
steps: Travel to the Lumbridge cow field east of the castle.
Kill the Cows (8 HP); no food is needed.
Collect cowhide for a little profit while completing the task.
notes: The cow field is fenced, so it is a compact, dense spot.

methods.label: Ranged or Magic
methods.summary: Attack the Cows with a bow or spells to train Ranged or Magic on a safe target.
requiredOrKeyItems: A shortbow and arrows, or air spells
steps: Bring a shortbow (or an air staff) to the cow field.
Attack the Cows; their negative defence bonuses make every hit land.
notes: Cows are a common low-level Ranged and Magic training target.
